name: WhatsApp Purchase Flow Identity and Conversation Guards
goal: Give each genuine WhatsApp purchase its own durable checkout identity, protect active commercial Orders from Conversation reset, and enforce the Conversation named-action state matrix.

identities.purchase_flow_id: one genuine WhatsApp purchase attempt; opaque UUID in Conversation.state_data
identities.order_idempotency_key: durable checkout identity derived from purchase_flow_id

checkout_identities.legacy_fallback: Only when a historical in-flight Conversation has no purchase_flow_id

active_order_authority.multiple_active_result: fail closed to support; never choose by age

restart_behavior.pre_commercial_flow: Restart may clear the current flow
restart_behavior.active_commercial_order: Restart, Stop, Back, Buy, and Resend preserve the Order link and return status or support guidance
restart_behavior.terminal_order: Restart is allowed; historical Order linkage remains; the next Buy creates a new purchase_flow_id

out_of_scope: Coupling verified resend challenges to purchase_flow_id
